truth.description: handleModuleSoftInvalidation matches each import in the kept code to an imported module by a url that keeps the base, but importAnalysis writes every import with config.base prepended while module urls carry none, so with a base other than / the timestamp rewrite never fires and a soft-invalidated importer keeps importing the stale module after an HMR update.

distractions.why: A module already seen is walked again only when its invalidation state changed, and a state can only move from soft to hard once, so the recursion still ends.
